# ThermoNeural

> ThermoNeural is the professional web platform for HVAC&R thermodynamics: simulate refrigeration cycles, analyze refrigerants, and run the business side of a contracting company — with NIST-verified accuracy via CoolProp.

ThermoNeural (https://thermoneural.com) serves HVAC&R engineers, technicians, contractors, and students. Public calculators and simulators run free in the browser; Pro plans add unlimited calculations, PDF reports, and the full business suite (jobs, clients, invoicing, dispatch).

## Main pages

- [Home](https://thermoneural.com/): Platform overview — engineering tools plus the business suite
- [Pricing](https://thermoneural.com/pricing): Free tier and Pro/Team/Enterprise plans

- [Contact](https://thermoneural.com/contact): Sales and support contact

## Free engineering tools

- [Load calculator](https://thermoneural.com/tools/load-calc): HVAC heating/cooling load calculations
- [Psychrometrics](https://thermoneural.com/tools/psychrometrics): Moisture-air property calculations
- [Standard vapor-compression cycle](https://thermoneural.com/tools/standard-cycle): Cycle simulator with COP and capacity
- [Cascade refrigeration cycle](https://thermoneural.com/tools/cascade-cycle): Two-stage cascade system simulation
- [Refrigerant comparison](https://thermoneural.com/tools/refrigerant-comparison): Side-by-side refrigerant properties
- [Refrigerant report](https://thermoneural.com/tools/refrigerant-report): Printable refrigerant property reports
- [Refrigerant inventory](https://thermoneural.com/tools/refrigerant-inventory): Charge tracking and leak-rate compliance
- [Leak-rate calculator](https://thermoneural.com/tools/leak-rate-calculator): EPA 608 leak-rate math
- [IAQ wizard](https://thermoneural.com/tools/iaq-wizard): Indoor air quality assessment
- [Diagnostic tool](https://thermoneural.com/tools/diagnose): Symptom-based fault diagnosis
- [Warranty scanner](https://thermoneural.com/tools/warranty-scanner): Equipment warranty lookup
